name: Respondent
description: Respondent is a participant-recruitment platform for research projects, screeners, audience targeting, scheduling, messaging, incentives, and study operations.
agentUseSummary: Add production Partner API credentials, then let selected agents read bounded Respondent targeting taxonomies. Relay does not expose projects, participants, screener responses, messages, bookings, financial data, webhooks, or mutations.

credentialRequirements.label: Respondent Client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the production Client ID issued by Respondent's Partner team.

credentialRequirements.label: Respondent Client Secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the matching production Client Secret issued by Respondent's Partner team.

capabilities.label: Read targeting taxonomies
capabilities.description: Use four pinned production GETs for bounded industries, job titles, skills, and topics.

allowed.label: Read Respondent taxonomies
allowed.description: Read bounded targeting taxonomies without projects, participants, responses, messages, or financial data.

blocked.label: Change Respondent
blocked.description: Projects, screeners, participants, responses, invitations, messages, bookings, payments, webhooks, and every mutation remain blocked.

blocked.label: Read sensitive research data
blocked.description: Projects, participant profiles, screener questions and responses, conversations, messages, bookings, NDAs, balances, payouts, and webhook destinations are blocked.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Staging APIs, arbitrary hosts, paths, queries, methods, request bodies, and unbounded taxonomy reads are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four bounded targeting-taxonomy reads run directly. Projects, participant data, responses, messages, financial data, arbitrary APIs, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one read tool with four pinned production taxonomy operations through encrypted Partner credentials.

providerSetup.blocker: No executed Partner agreement, production organization and team, production Client ID and Client Secret, or safe fixture is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized customer completes Respondent's Partner onboarding and production review, stores the issued production credentials through Relay Console, then verifies authentication, the four bounded taxonomy reads, assignment, credential replacement, disconnect, provider-side rotation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Respondent documents production and staging API hosts, Client ID and Client Secret authentication headers, rate limits, and its recruitment-focused Partner API.
Respondent requires Partner-team onboarding, staging credentials and review, a finalized agreement, and separately issued production credentials.

The official OpenAPI schema documents paginated GET routes for industries, job titles, skills, and topics plus the much broader project, participant, message, payment, and webhook surface Relay excludes.
Production access requires reviewed project, screener, participant-state, messaging, auto-pay, organization, team, and contractual setup, supporting awaiting-provider-setup status.
